name: Oriental Kopi Holdings Berhad
overview: 今年公司主要推进产能扩张：通过间接全资子公司以RM23.00百万收购雪兰莪Kuala Langat一幅约5,262平方米的租赁土地及厂房，用于支持业务运营。其他公告主要为公司治理、股东大会及关联交易股东授权等常规事项，未披露其他业务板块的扩张、缩减或合约信息。
overview_en: The main business development this year was capacity expansion: through an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary, the company proposed to acquire a leasehold land with a factory building measuring approximately 5,262 square metres in Kuala Langat, Selangor for RM23.00 million in cash to support business operations.

segments.name: 集团 / Group

segments.note_en: The main announcement this year was the proposed acquisition of a leasehold land with a factory building measuring approximately 5,262 square metres in Kuala Langat, Selangor for a cash consideration…

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公司就上述收购作出进一步公告，该收购事项仍在推进中。
actions.text_en: The company made a further announcement on the above proposed acquisition, which is still in progress.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 间接全资子公司Oriental Coffee International Sdn. Bhd.拟以RM23.00百万现金收购雪兰莪Kuala Langat一幅约5,262平方米的租赁土地及厂房。
actions.text_en: Indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Oriental Coffee International Sdn. Bhd. proposed to acquire a leasehold land with a factory building measuring approximately 5,262 square metres in Kuala Langat, Selangor for a cash consideration of RM23.00 million.
